discussion.body:
Render pass aimed at the accepted layout sheet (https://i.imgur.com/mCfISje.jpeg): central rain-well dome, west and east pavilions, circular tide-pool terrace, Queen's Cove stair, Undertow chamber in the cliff. Overcast, no caustic light. Layout remains the spec; this plate is for match check.
Local: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-023-templewater-match-layout.jpg.
